name: Windsor

prices.note: 1,367 regular-price in-stock dresses in the full feed (15,105 products, 1,846 in stock dresses, 479 of them marked down). Regular = in stock, no variant with compare_at_price above price; title must name a dress or gown. Low: Velvet Rope Sequin Lace Up Bodycon Mini Dress $14; high: Alyson Tulle Pearl Beaded Formal Dress $199.90. Median $64.90; 1,253 (92%) under $100. 441 long (maxi/gown/formal) at $38.90–$199.90.

notes: Our Story (windsorstore.com/pages/our-story): opened 1937; 'owned and operated by generations of the Zekaria family'; timeline: 1937 founded by 2 brothers as a hosiery and lingerie store, 1957 'Began focusing on special occasion dresses', 1998 online store, 2015 100 stores, 2019 200 stores; 'over 350+ stores and through our online shop'. Mission moments named: 'your first kiss at the dance, graduation, New Year's Eve and the wedding party'.

Locations page: 'Find a Windsor Store near you from over 350 locations'; 'homecoming to prom'; 'each location has an incredible selection of dresses for both casual and formal events'. FashionUnited (2026-03-10 per URL): 'more than 350 locations across the US and Canada'. RetailBoss (Oct 22 2025, Jeanel Alvarado): 'a leading American women's fashion retailer recognized for its affordable yet elegant designs'; 'the go-to destination for eveningwear, prom dresses, and event-ready apparel'. hq_country US from these.

Shipping: homepage promo 'Unlock Free Shipping on Orders $75+ or $40+ with a Top or Bottom' and ticker 'Free shipping $75+ sitewide' (US). Ships-to list from the store's own Shopify policy search (/api/mcp, search_shop_policies_and_faqs): includes US, CA, GB, AU and ~100 others. Product JSON-LD ShippingDetails: handling 1–2 days, transit 2–11 days.

Returns: product-page JSON-LD MerchantReturnPolicy: merchantReturnDays 30, ReturnByMail, FreeReturn. Dress products also carry the tag 'HR-refund:14days', and the official returns article (customerserviceportal.windsorstore.com) returns 403 to WebFetch, so whether dresses get a cash refund only within 14 days is unconfirmed (human_check). /pages/support is a Cloudflare challenge; not worked around.

Size guide: XXS (US 00) to XL (US 15), bust 28–40 in., waist 22–34 in. In-stock dresses: S 1,580, XS 1,527, M 1,503, L 1,457, XL 492, XXS 272. Old sold-out items show 1X–3X; none in stock, so has_plus false for current stock.
Every dress in the feed has vendor 'Windsor' (own label), so kind brand.
